description:
Elixir: Enum.zip([1..3, [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]]) is [{1, 4, 7}, {2, 5, 8}, {3, 6, 9}]: tuples as wide as the number of enumerables, known only at run time. fz has no way to build a tuple from a list (no List.to_tuple/1, no Tuple primitive that takes a list; grep of lib/ finds none), so Enum.zip/1 cannot be written in lib. On fz-sc8.173 both Enum.zip([a, b]) calls fail with resolve/unknown-import: module Enum does not export zip/1.

Build: List.to_tuple/1 as in Elixir (needs a runtime primitive on interp, run and build), then Enum.zip/1 over zip_with_lists. Related: fz-sc8.109 (Tuple remaining surface). Also missing from Enum, seen in the same check against Elixir: chunk_every/3,4, min_max/2, max/3, min/3, count_until/3.
title: Enum.zip/1 and List.to_tuple/1
